name: gemini_delegate
description: Delegate a well-defined implementation task to Gemini (Antigravity CLI). The work happens in an isolated git worktree on a dedicated branch: the main repo is NOT touched until you call gemini_apply. Asynchronous: returns a job_id immediately (you can launch several in parallel on independent parts). Use gemini_jobs to wait for / view the diff. Ideal for: boilerplate, tests, mechanical refactors, repetitive migrations, documentation, small features with a clear spec. Do NOT use it for architectural decisions or hard bugs.

task.description: Complete, self-contained spec: what to do, where, constraints. Gemini cannot see your conversation.

files.description: Relevant files/folders (paths relative to the repo)

context.description: Useful context: conventions, APIs to use, existing examples to imitate

test_command.description: Command Gemini must run to verify its work (e.g. 'npm test -- auth')

include_uncommitted.description: Start from the current state including uncommitted changes (default true). Untracked files are not included.

model.description: Model to use: a group (fast, standard, strong, frontier) or an exact slug from gemini_models. A group always picks the best model of that group available on this account. Omit it to use the configured default.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. For models whose slug ends with a level (e.g. -low, -high), the matching variant of the same model is picked instead.

wait_seconds.description: If > 0, wait up to N seconds (max 600) and return the result directly

name: gemini_analyze
description: Ask Gemini (~1M token context) to read and analyze code in READ-ONLY mode and return a dense summary with path:line references. Use it to save your own context: exploring large codebases, huge files, logs, finding where something is implemented, mapping dependencies, preliminary reviews. Synchronous.

question.description: What you want to know, as specifically as possible

model.description: Model to use: a group (fast, standard, strong, frontier) or an exact slug from gemini_models. A group always picks the best model of that group available on this account. Omit it to use the configured default.

effort.description: Reasoning effort. For models whose slug ends with a level (e.g. -low, -high), the matching variant of the same model is picked instead.

name: gemini_jobs
description: Status of delegated jobs. Without job_id: list of the repo's jobs. With job_id: details including Gemini's response and the diff. wait_seconds waits for the jobs (or the given one) to finish.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to N seconds (max 600) for the job / all active jobs to finish

include_diff.description: Include the diff in the details (default true)

name: gemini_apply
description: Apply a completed job's changes (after reviewing them) to the main repo's working tree, then remove the job's worktree and branch. The changes stay UNCOMMITTED so you can touch them up and test them.

keep_worktree.description: Do not delete the worktree/branch (default false)

name: gemini_discard
description: Discard a job (stopping it if running) and delete its worktree and branch.

name: gemini_usage
description: Gemini usage over the last 24h against the configured budget, active jobs, configuration, and a check that agy is installed.

name: gemini_models
description: List the models this account can use through agy, grouped by capability (fast, standard, strong, frontier, other), and show which model is used by default for analysis and for implementation. With analyze/implement/exclude it also changes those defaults (saved across sessions). The list is re-read from `agy models` every few hours, so new models appear on their own. Does not use the daily budget.

refresh.description: Re-read `agy models` now. Also forgets models marked unavailable after a failed run.

analyze.description: Default model for gemini_analyze: a group (follows new models automatically), an exact slug (pinned), or "auto" to go back to the automatic choice.

implement.description: Default model for gemini_delegate: a group, an exact slug, or "auto".

exclude.description: Slug patterns (* wildcard) never chosen through a group or by default, e.g. ["claude-*"]. Replaces the current list; [] clears it.

name: gemini_mode
description: Show or change the delegation mode, i.e. how much you should delegate to Gemini: off (tools disabled), manual (only when the user asks), auto (your judgment, the default), prefer (delegate whatever makes sense). There is a global default plus per-repo settings. Without arguments it shows the current mode for this repo. Change it only when the user asks.

mode.description: New mode. "inherit" removes this repo's setting (or, with scope global, goes back to the built-in default).

scope.description: Where to save it: this repo only (default) or the global default.
